exposure: Neonatal Resuscitation Program 2015 guideline alteration (Epoch-I vs Epoch-II)
cohort: The study included 168 periviable infants born at 22-25 weeks gestational age between 2010 and 2019 in a single center, excluding those with congenital anomalies and parent-decided comfort care.
finding: Periviable infants born after the implementation of the NRP 2015 guideline alteration (Epoch-II, 2016-2019) had significantly higher odds of survival compared to those born before (Epoch-I, 2010-2015).
mod_finding: Cesarean delivery was found to be a significant risk factor associated with the survival of periviable infants.
